rules.label: Explainable verdicts
rules.because: Automated governance verdicts require reason and evidence.
evidence: release-governance.json categories include because and evidence

rules.label: Registered capabilities
rules.because: Every capability has an id, owner, dependencies and layer.

rules.label: Behaviour contracts required
rules.because: Active and foundation capabilities explicitly declare whether behaviour contracts are required.

rules.label: Provider-neutral AI boundary
rules.because: Feature code is not allowed to call named AI providers directly.

rules.label: Industry-neutral Platform Core
rules.because: Core runtime files are scanned for forbidden industry and experience identifiers.

rules.label: Three-layer placement
rules.because: Capabilities declare a platform-core, domain-pack or experience layer.

rules.label: Release identity consistency
rules.because: Manifest, Worker, registry and release records share the current platform identity.
